
Two arXiv papers from the 2026-05-25 scout pass meet ≥3 inclusion criteria with strong signal. EVE-Agent addresses self-evolving agent architecture with evidence-based verification loops; BOHM addresses observability and attribution for compound AI systems. Grok social signals were all unverifiable URLs (no confirmed existence) and are excluded.

## Suggestions

- [EVE-Agent: Evidence-Verifiable Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22905) — Proposes an evidence-verifiable self-evolving agent architecture that integrates verification loops and iterative self-improvement into the agent lifecycle, with empirical evaluation on complex reasoning tasks.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (self-evolving agent design, verification-driven architecture), Iterative refinement practices (evidence-based verification loops, self-improvement cycles), Empirical or practical grounding (benchmarked on reasoning tasks)

- [BOHM: Zero-Cost Hierarchical Attribution for Compound AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22866) — Introduces a zero-cost hierarchical attribution framework for compound AI systems, enabling fine-grained observability and credit assignment across multi-component agentic pipelines without runtime overhead.
  Section: Research Papers | Criteria: Architectural guidance for goal-directed agent systems (hierarchical attribution across compound AI components), Iterative refinement practices (observability and feedback signal design for multi-agent pipelines), Empirical or practical grounding (zero-cost overhead validated empirically, production-deployment relevance)
